briefdescription.para: Return the base address of the memory access.

detaileddescription.para: This may either be a normal LLVM IR Value, or one of the special values used in CodeGen. Special values are those obtained via PseudoSourceValue::getFixedStack(int), PseudoSourceValue::getStack, and other PseudoSourceValue member functions which return objects which stand for frame/stack pointer relative references and other special references which are not representable in the high-level IR.

briefdescription.para: Return the raw flags of the source value,.
Bitwise OR the current flags with the given flags.
For normal values, this is a byte offset added to the base address.

detaileddescription.para: For PseudoSourceValue::FPRel values, this is the FrameIndex number.

briefdescription.para: Return the memory type of the memory reference.

detaileddescription.para: This should only be relied on for GlobalISel G_* operation legalization.

briefdescription.para: Return the size in bytes of the memory reference.
Return the size in bits of the memory reference.
Return the minimum known alignment in bytes of the actual memory reference.

detaileddescription.para: getAlign - Return the minimum known alignment in bytes of the actual memory reference.

briefdescription.para: Return the minimum known alignment in bytes of the base address, without the offset.
Return the AA tags for the memory reference.
Return the range tag for the memory reference.
Returns the synchronization scope ID for this memory operation.
Return the atomic ordering requirements for this memory operation.

detaileddescription.para: For cmpxchg atomic operations, return the atomic ordering requirements when store occurs.

briefdescription.para: For cmpxchg atomic operations, return the atomic ordering requirements when store does not occur.
Return a single atomic ordering that is at least as strong as both the success and failure orderings for an atomic operation.

detaileddescription.para: (For operations other than cmpxchg, this is equivalent to getSuccessOrdering().)

briefdescription.para: Returns true if this operation has an atomic ordering requirement of unordered or higher, false otherwise.
Returns true if this memory operation doesn't have any ordering constraints other than normal aliasing.

detaileddescription.para: Volatile and (ordered) atomic memory operations can't be reordered.

briefdescription.para: Update this MachineMemOperand to reflect the alignment of MMO, if it has a greater alignment.

detaileddescription.para: This must only be used when the new alignment applies to all users of this MachineMemOperand.

briefdescription.para: Change the SourceValue for this MachineMemOperand.

detaileddescription.para: This should only be used when an object is being relocated and all references to it are being updated.

briefdescription.para: Reset the tracked memory type.
Unset the tracked range metadata.
A description of a memory reference used in the backend.

detaileddescription.para: Instead of holding a StoreInst or LoadInst, this class holds the address Value of the reference along with a byte size and offset. This allows it to describe lowered loads and stores. Also, the special PseudoSourceValue objects can be used to represent loads and stores to memory locations that aren't explicit in the regular LLVM IR.
